 Press release
 Joint Statement on Iran, 12 October
 English 
 العربيَّة 
 Joint Statement from Foreign Ministers regarding RAF Fairford and Iran State Threats.
 From: 
 Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office and The Rt Hon Ed Miliband MP 
 Published: 
 12 October 2026 
 The Foreign Ministers of Australia, Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Canada, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, the United Kingdom and the United States condemn in the strongest terms Iran’s use of violent attacks, including the acts of lethal plotting, arson, sabotage, cyber-attacks, and other hybrid activities against us and our partners. 
 We recognise the United Kingdom’s attribution of Iran’s involvement in the incident at RAF Fairford on 27 September.  The UK has also concluded this event demonstrates the IRGC’s continued willingness to project hostile activity beyond its borders through covert networks and proxy actors. 
 This comes soon after the recent campaign of attacks across Europe targeting Jewish communities, Iranian journalists, and U.S. interests, claimed by Harakat Ashab al-Yamin al-Islamiya (HAYI). 
 Any attempt by Iran to threaten, silence, intimidate, harass, harm, or coerce people on our territories through proxies or any other means is unacceptable.  Anyone who conducts hostile activities on behalf of Iran, or any other state, should know that we will take action to identify, investigate, disrupt, and prosecute these acts.  Iran should be in no doubt that we are united and remain committed to safeguarding our sovereignty and strengthening our international coordination, bolstering our national resilience, protecting our communities, and ensuring that those responsible are held to account.
 Media enquiries
 Email newsdesk@fcdo.gov.uk 
 Telephone 020 7008 3100
 Email the FCDO Newsdesk (monitored 24 hours a day) in the first instance, and we will respond as soon as possible.
